goal: Close the remaining wave-1 UX items from the analysis: chat rooms scroll to new messages and label canned replies as fallback, a Journal delete waits five seconds with Hoàn tác, the composer says drafts are kept, and Android Back steps back inside the app instead of leaving it.
successCriteria: Persona chat scrolls to the newest message and marks fallback replies.
Journal delete hides the entry and deletes it after five seconds unless Hoàn tác is tapped.
The composer tells the person their draft stays on the device.
Android Back closes dialogs, steps back in Tarot and chat rooms and returns to Hôm nay from other tabs; Astrology keeps its own handler.
Mobile check and Jest suite pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No backend, deploy, SQL or settings change.
